name: Folio edit-mode erase patch
when_to_use: Use when Edit mode in the pinned Folio revision should delete one character at a time and remove a baked-in text line from the PDF. Apply the patch to that revision. Folio is not vendored here.

how_to_change.note: The patch is applied to Folio at 0590fac31d915810c881ca6144fc7e8bb32e82c0. Keep the upstream MIT copyright. Do not vendor the Folio tree or describe a white box as deletion. Do not promote this to canonical.
